title: Mongo: TLS cert rotation (Vault re-issue + rolling restart)
description: Runs `nexus cert-rotate mongo`: per node, issues a fresh leaf via the node's own Vault token (pki_int/issue/mongo-server), writes the combined server.pem + ca.crt, and rolling-restarts nexus-mongo.

observe.what: per-node old serial != new serial, error column empty for all 3 (rolling, ~70s)

whatProves: MongoAdapter.RotateCertAsync performs a genuine Vault re-issue (not a cache replay) and a rolling restart that the RS tolerates (one member down at a time).
